title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Bengali artists love devotional and folk songs. These songs inspire singers and audiences alike. They celebrate culture and faith, creating a shared experience.

title: Tobu Bhalobashi
desc: While driving on a rainy day, Raj accidently kills a person. Following the incident, Raj visits the victim's family to inform about his sad demise, but ends up falling in love with his pregnant wife.

title: Porinaam
desc: Raghu falls in love with Nisha, but her father opposes their union. To gain his approval, Raghu decides to enter her house disguised as a servant.

title: Beder Meye Josna
desc: A prince, bitten by a snake, is saved by the healer Josna, who falls ill in the process. Recovered, she demands his hand in marriage, leading to a royal tug-of-war for love.

title: Sundar Bou
desc: Sabitri, who is married to Nanda, is exploited daily by her mother-in-law. Seeing this, her uncle decides to help her overcome her problems.

title: Pratham Dekha
desc: Two struggling singers, who hope to make their way to the top, fall in love and fight to stay together amidst various societal barriers.
